Troubleshooting · 43/50 · delivery

Delivery manifest incomplete

Failure signal

A delivery manifest incomplete condition is reported or detected during delivery.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for delivery does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Compare expected deliverables with file inventory, sizes, hashes, languages and dependencies.

Corrective action

Regenerate the manifest from verified files and resolve every missing or extra item.

Prevention

Add this verification to the delivery gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
